name: Career & Learning
tagline: Keeps a career goal moving: maps the abilities you lack, then walks the plan with you.
description: Choose the move you want - a bigger title, a jump to another field, or more depth in the seat you already hold - and it works out which abilities stand between you and it. Then it stays on the case: regular check-ins on what you have practised, what comes next, and a nudge when you let the plan drift.
author: mjplaskett
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
